Centre Issues Eviction Notice to Delhi Gymkhana Club

The Indian government has issued a show-cause notice to the Delhi Gymkhana Club as part of eviction proceedings. The notice cites the club's continued occupation of the land after the government resumed possession for public purposes as "unauthorized occupation." The club has been asked to respond by July 7, 2026, explaining why an eviction order should not be issued.
